next.reason: 1985: '[ALL] HIGH-VALUE(S) Except in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph, represents one or more of the character that has the highest ordinal position in the program collating sequence'. 2023: 'The character that has the highest ordinal position in the program collating sequence is associated with the figurative constant HIGH-VALUE, except when this figurative constant is specified as a literal in the SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph' (§2023:12.3.7.4 GR8), the [ALL] HIGH-VALUE(S) spellings in §2023:8.3.3.6.2, and §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR6. The multiple-character, LC_COLLATE, national and runtime-sequence cases in GR6 apply only to locales, national contexts and SET of the collating sequence, which this 1985 rule neither allows nor refuses; for every program the 1985 rule governs the value is the same. 'One or more' (repetition) is the length rules, not this definition.
